title: Implement Scoring System and LocalStorage High Score Table
description: Implement a score tracker that increments as the player successfully passes pipes, and persists the highest score locally using browser LocalStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Score increments by 1 for each successfully bypassed pipe obstacle
High score updates and persists across sessions using LocalStorage API
Python unit tests verify scoring increments and high score sorting logic
reviewFeedback: The implementation correctly satisfies all acceptance criteria, adheres to immutability and modularity principles, handles LocalStorage exceptions safely, and passes all associated test suites.
